focus: control-plane correctness: one durable ModelSelectionState, append-on-every-semantic-change, Auto fixed after real process restarts and exposed through the production API, crash-durable manual selections, exhaustive fail-closed reconstruction, deterministic decision identity, scorer/config telemetry stamps, and the runtime authority-invariant layer
fixes: releaseToAuto derives current state from the DURABLE event log — Auto works after a true process restart (fresh-Session regression), never gated on the WeakMap

session.selectModel accepts the discriminated mode:'auto' payload (RPC type + wire schema + handler): releases manual authority and resets the effective selection to the deployment default through a NON-CLAIMING reset, so stale or foreign picked routes cannot impersonate manual choices

the API-proxy selection getter consults the durable manual state (complete selection, reasoning effort included) BEFORE the logged request header — manual selections are crash-durable ahead of the header

event suppression compares the COMPLETE semantic state (mode/authority/provider/model/reasoningEffort/source): same-authority Pro-to-Flash switches and provenance changes record; only true no-ops are skipped
ModelSelectionState is one durable union (auto: router|default; manual: user|sdk|policy|subagent-owner + complete selection); the WeakMap is explicitly a cache

reconstruction is exhaustive (default is a real state) and conservative: future authority schema versions fail CLOSED (router defers) instead of resurrecting superseded history; v0.15.3 schema-1 events map forward
claimModelSelection validates authority/source combinations against an allowlist; manual claims without a complete route are rejected at the write boundary
routingDecisionId is DETERMINISTIC — sha256(session:turn:step:policyVersion:configFingerprint) via routingDecisionIdentity — decideRoute contains no randomness

every decision stamps scorerVersion and configFingerprint (canonical SHA-256 over the effective configuration): experiments can attribute decisions to the exact scoring implementation and configuration

the ./invariant companion polices the control plane at runtime: epoch monotonicity, manual-states-carry-selections / auto-states-carry-none, router decisions never supersede manual authority without an Auto release, deterministic ids and telemetry stamps present, future schemas rejected
